use_scope: Private noncommercial technical research/demo mockup inference only; no training/finetuning/public redistribution. EXIF rotation/color normalization/metadata removal, no resize; generated clothing edits indicated.
rights_uncertainty: Individual releases, photographer/catalog rights and age records not independently verified. Selected catalog people visually appear adult. Source research/NC adaptation permission checked; no express third-party processing restriction found. Mirror bytes not compared with official archive.
coverage_limit: VITON-HD is frontal-view catalog data: no strong side/seated condition, and selected hand-on-head poses are not overhead full-arm poses. Abstract graphic checks are not a fine regular plaid test. No garment material composition is certified from appearance.
